snippet.title: Jingle Janitor | Gameplay | Tidy Santa's Workshop with Magic Spells and Couch Co-op
snippet.description:
2½ minutes of Jingle Janitor gameplay: sorting toy parts onto their shelves, sweeping, magic spells, a snowball fight in split-screen co-op, the Elf Express and the Christmas Miracle. No voice-over, just the game.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5445800/
Coming December 2026.

Chapters:
0:00 Tidy the workshop: pick up, sort, sweep
0:19 First spells: Part Finder and Snowflake Sprite
0:35 Snowballs: targets and a co-op snowball fight
1:02 Gravity Magic and the Gingerbread Crew
1:19 Ride the Elf Express
1:35 The Christmas Miracle
1:54 Every shelf full

Your first night as Santa's janitor, and the elves partied all night. Sort a gloriously messy workshop until every toy part sits on its shelf, learn handy magic, cheer up the elves and save Christmas. Cozy first-person tidying, alone or with a friend on the couch.

Accessibility built in: rebind every action (keyboard, mouse, any controller), toggles instead of holds, aim assist, text size, high contrast, captions and reduced motion. In English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and Russian.

Made by Dreamt Madness, a two-person indie studio.
https://dreamtmadness.com/games/jingle-janitor/

#JingleJanitor #CozyGames #IndieGame
